  horizontal strip cut from a larger leaf. Top and bottom edges cut through

  that I can distinguish from the marginal dashes, no interlinear gloss.

  column a lines 21-23.

  paragraph mark, in a disputation style (the recurring words below suggest
  objections and replies). I do not infer more.
